post.summary: Send a password-reset email. Always returns ok — neutral regardless of whether the account exists.
Re-send the signup confirmation email. Always returns ok — neutral regardless of whether the address maps to an unconfirmed account.
Create an account (ban/retired-username checks, referral + locale metadata). A confirmation email follows via the existing Supabase template.

get.summary: Best Play of the Week banner — nominations, vote tallies, and the caller's own vote, when the voting window is open.

post.summary: Vote for a Best Play of the Week nomination — one vote per player per week.

get.summary: This week's community challenges and the caller's progress.

delete.summary: Delete (soft) your own comment. Naturally idempotent, author-only.

post.summary: Report a comment to staff. post_id is resolved server-side, never trusted from the client.

get.summary: Pinned + boosted + paginated community feed posts.
Most recent posts with an image, for the gallery grid.

post.summary: Create a manual community post (text and/or up to 5 images).

delete.summary: Delete (soft) your own post. Naturally idempotent, author-only.

get.summary: One post plus its comments (same PostView shape as the feed).

post.summary: Boost your own manual post to the top of the feed for 24h (200 coins).

get.summary: A post's comments (author join, is_deleted filtered, chronological — capped at 50).

post.summary: Create a flat (non-threaded) comment on a post.

delete.summary: Remove the caller's reaction on a post. Naturally idempotent.

put.summary: Set the caller's reaction on a post. Idempotent — replaying the same reaction is a no-op.

post.summary: Report a post to staff.

get.summary: Member/country/tournament counts for the community stats bar.
Live (24h) status rings for the story tray, grouped and ordered per player.

post.summary: Post a 24h status (image and/or caption — at least one required).

delete.summary: Delete your own status. Naturally idempotent, author-only.

post.summary: Mark a status viewed. Best-effort — always succeeds; naturally idempotent by construction.

get.summary: A status's viewer list — server-enforced to the status's own author (RLS returns empty for anyone else).
Top 5 members by XP.
Upcoming tournaments shown as community events.
Runtime configuration, kill-switch and feature flags (unauthenticated, cacheable).

delete.summary: Unregister this device’s token (call before sign-out).

post.summary: Register (or move to this account) this device’s native FCM token.
Report an app crash/exception into client_error_logs. Works signed-out. Never fails the caller.

get.summary: Public Hall of Fame awards, champions by tier, and bronze finishes with optional game filter.
Home: banners, live/upcoming tournaments, leaderboard teaser, hall-of-fame teaser, platform stats. Public — visible logged out, same as the web home page.

post.summary: Accept a season invitation — confirms immediately if free, else opens a Paystack transaction.
Decline a season invitation — cascades to the next invitee.
Submit a placement/kills result for one lobby (BR/points-race formats) for admin review.

get.summary: Composed Match Centre view: participation, check-in state, wager pools/window, no-show eligibility.

post.summary: Mark the signed-in player present for a match.
Rate your opponent 1-5 stars after a confirmed match result.
Submit a match result (screenshot required) for admin review.
Place or change a coin wager on a match you are not playing in.

get.summary: The signed-in user, their roles (drives the role-aware Admin section) and own profile.
The signed-in player's SX Coin ledger, newest first, 20 per page. Cursor-paged; `source` is a raw code.
The signed-in player's own follow sets. The app derives 'Following' and 'Follows you' from this — public responses never carry viewer state.

patch.summary: Update the signed-in player's own profile (display name, bio, country, one-time username change, avatar).

get.summary: Owner-only progress: XP and membership tier (with progress to the next tier, null at max), SX Score, coin balance, and the active DLS season standing (null with no active season).
Dashboard fixtures summary: next fixture, submit-result prompt, active registrations, qualify/eliminate banners.
The signed-in player's SX Score ledger, newest first, 20 per page. Cursor-paged; `eventType` is a raw code. Staff notes are never returned.
The signed-in player's XP ledger, newest first, 20 per page. Cursor-paged; `source` is a raw code.

delete.summary: Unsend your own message within 10 minutes of sending. Naturally idempotent.

patch.summary: Edit your own message within 10 minutes of sending.

post.summary: Copy a visible message into another of your threads. Idempotent.

delete.summary: Remove a block you placed. Naturally idempotent.

put.summary: Block a player from messaging you (also severs follows in both directions). Idempotent.

post.summary: Mark every message addressed to the caller as delivered. Best-effort.

get.summary: One keyset page of the caller's conversations, newest activity first (blocked threads hidden). box=inbox (default) or box=requests.

post.summary: Get or create the 1:1 thread with a player. A new thread starts as a pending request unless the pair is exempt. Naturally idempotent.

get.summary: Thread header: the other player and who has blocked whom. 404 if the caller is not a participant.

post.summary: Accept a pending message request. Only the player who did not start the thread may; naturally idempotent.
Decline a pending message request. Only the player who did not start the thread may; naturally idempotent. The sender sees the same outcome as a block.

get.summary: One page of messages, newest first, with signed media URLs and resolved reply previews.

post.summary: Send a text, photo, sticker or voice note. Idempotent: a retried send never creates a second message or push.
Mark a thread read and delivered, and clear its bell rows. Best-effort.
Report the other player in a thread (optionally citing one message) for staff review.
Mark one of your notifications read. Already read is a success; an unknown or someone else’s id is 404.

delete.summary: Unmute a type (clears the timed row and any "always" flag) or a post thread. Naturally idempotent.

get.summary: Live (unexpired) timed mutes. A type muted "always" is not listed here; it is push[type] = false in the prefs.

post.summary: Mute a notification type or a post thread for 1h, 1w or always. "always" for a type flips push[type] = false (and clears any timed row); "always" for a post is a far-future expiry.

get.summary: Effective notification preferences (push 17, WhatsApp 6, achievement sharing 5). An absent stored key resolves to its default; a type muted "always" shows as push[type] = false.

patch.summary: Merge-patch any subset of the preference sections; each present section is merged atomically. Unknown keys or non-booleans are rejected. Returns the full effective prefs.

post.summary: Mark all of your unread notifications read; returns how many were updated.
Send a clearly labelled test push to your own registered devices through the real sender. 404 if you have no registered device; 500 if nothing could be delivered.

Complete the compulsory profile step — country, WhatsApp number (normalised to E.164 for the chosen country), WhatsApp-updates consent and at least one game interest. Atomic: stamps profileCompletedAt only if every field was saved.
Claim a username after email confirmation — resolveOnboardingGate’s first step.

get.summary: Poll a Paystack registration payment's confirmation status. The webhook remains the source of truth; this is UI polling only.
Player directory search (max 60, ranked by SX Score). Public. Unlike the web page it cannot exclude the signed-in viewer (responses are identical for everyone) — the app filters its own username.
Public player profile. 404 for unknown and deleted accounts. Locked achievements are never described — only total/unlockedCount. Identical for every caller.

put.summary: Follow a player. Idempotent: a replay returns the stored response and sends no second notification. `created` is false when already following.

get.summary: Who follows this player (max 100, newest first). Public.
Who this player follows (max 100, newest first). Public.
Public leaderboard with literal web metric-tab ordering, filters, pagination, trend and streak.
Authenticated viewer global rank in the selected leaderboard scope and metric.
All seasons, newest first.
One season with per-game tournaments, provisional-aware standings and tier labels.

post.summary: Runs login()'s server-side side-effects (daily login coins/XP/streak) and reports deletion-pending status. Call once per app process after a session exists — not on every screen visit.
Create a squad for a squad-entry tournament and receive its invite code.

get.summary: Preview a squad by its invite code before committing to join it.
Group standings, fixtures, and knockout rounds for one tournament.

post.summary: Register for a tournament — waiver, zero-fee, coin-discount-to-zero, or Paystack, in that precedence.

get.summary: The tournament's game-specific registration identity fields, for rendering a dynamic form.
Registration view-state, fee, waiver and coin-discount eligibility for one tournament, for the caller (or a logged-out guest).
Champion (if resolved) and no-winner status for a completed tournament.
Points-race stage standings (round-robin/BR). Group standings live in GET /tournaments/{id}/bracket instead.

post.summary: Join the waitlist once registration has closed — no payment step.
